title: [v0.92.1][V3-F] Repair Sprint 5/6 cutover blockers
body:
Closes #596
Part-Of #505
Part-Of #534

This PR packages the bounded Sprint 5/6 cutover-review remediation branch without making C-SDLC v3 live authority.

Changes:
- Adds typed lifecycle repair for #596 so implementation, review, publication, merge, finish, and cleanup can be gated normally instead of leaving the issue open after merge.
- Adds a safe C-SDLC v2 path to reapprove ready design references only when SPP and VPP point at the canonical authored design/diagram paths and only the content digests changed.
- Adds a safe bind-adoption path for an already-advanced ready issue in its exact current FastWork branch/worktree, rejecting topology mismatch and later lifecycle evidence.
- Fixes terminal materialization after duplicate publication so a historical merged terminal PR can supersede stale open publication state without accepting caller-forged terminal or issue identity.
- Brings the v3 full replacement denominator and real-issue canaries onto this remediation branch, proving v3 is still incomplete for #505 cutover while exercising current #596 and terminal #4646 records.

Validation:
- `csdlc-validate issue --issue 596`
- `bash .csdlc/prepared/issues/596/validate-remediation-regression.sh`
- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml terminal_materialization_policy_tests --lib`
- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml ready_unbound --lib`
- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml prebind_contract_repair_is_exact_atomic_and_fail_closed --test gate2`
- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --test real_issue_canary`
- `git diff --check`

Non-claims:
- Leaves issue #505 open; no v3 authority cutover, v2 retirement, merge, finish, or cleanup authority is claimed by this PR.
head: codex/sprints-5-6-cutover-fixes
